assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Health Background
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: The following questions help us understand if you and others will be safe if you have access to firearms. A ‘yes’ answer does not mean your application will be refused but it may lead to further examination. If you answer ‘yes’ to any of the items in section F.1, you must provide a certificate from your health practitioner. Note: The certificate should state the nature of the health condition, whether it has been resolved, any on-going treatment, and whether they believe (having considered the interests of the safety of individuals, including yourself, or the public) you are a suitable person to use or possess a firearm, including if there are any limitations to possession or use that may be warranted.
